Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
class Solution(object):
    def canPlaceFlowers(self, flowerbed, n):
        """
        :type flowerbed: List[int]
        :type n: int
        :rtype: bool
        """
        for i in range(len(flowerbed)):
            empty_left = (i == 0) or (flowerbed[i-1] == 0)
            empty_right = (i == len(flowerbed)-1) or (flowerbed[i+1] == 0)

            if flowerbed[i] == 0 and empty_left and empty_right:
                flowerbed[i] = 1
                n-=1
        
        return n <= 0
